description: Create a consent request for a member to share their financial behaviour data.
exampleRequest:
POST /v1/consent/requests
Authorization: Bearer mnya_live_••••4f2a
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "memberPhone": "+250788000111",
  "purpose": "loan_eligibility",
  "durationDays": 90
}

description: Check the status of a consent request — granted, declined, withdrawn or pending.
Submit a batch of consented records (core banking, MoMo, SACCO ledger or savings group) for scoring.
exampleRequest:
POST /v1/uploads
Authorization: Bearer mnya_live_••••4f2a
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "source": "core_banking",
  "recordCount": 18420,
  "fileUrl": "https://uploads.menya.africa/batches/b_19a3.csv"
}

description: Fetch a member's current inclusion or repayment score, with its top contributing factors.
exampleResponse:
200 OK

{
  "memberId": "mem_7c21",
  "model": "inclusion-score",
  "version": "v2.3",
  "score": 0.81,
  "topFactors": [
    "Regular savings group contributions",
    "Consistent MoMo cash-in frequency"
  ]
}

description: List the loan products an institution can match consented members against.
Register an endpoint to receive consent, upload and score events for this institution.
exampleRequest:
POST /v1/webhooks
Authorization: Bearer mnya_live_••••4f2a
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "url": "https://partner.example.rw/menya/webhook",
  "events": ["consent.granted", "upload.completed"]
}
